title: workflow.tool.approval.requested.v1 payload
description: A Temporal workflow paused awaiting human approval of an AI-proposed or workflow-embedded action (ADR-004, §7). The control plane surfaces this to authorized approvers; the decision returns as a Temporal signal.

approval_id.description: PostgreSQL approvals row; the audit anchor.

workflow_id.description: Temporal business workflow ID, e.g. refund-{org}-{orderId}.

risk_level.description: From the tool registry (ADR-009); drives approval policy.

proposed_by.description: Actor format; typically chatbot:{uuid} or system.

summary.description: Human-readable action summary for the approver. Full arguments are read from PostgreSQL under authorization — not carried on the bus.

amount.description: Monetary amount when applicable (refunds), in minor units.

required_permission.description: Permission an approver must hold (fail closed, §16).

expires_at.description: After this, the workflow's timer fails the approval closed (RULES-failure-retry).
